run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-17T07:18:59Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend is explained by frontend HTTP 500s whose innermost errors are TCP connection refusals to frontend's dependencies ad and payment. At 07:17:25Z, shortly before the alert began, Deployments ad and payment were rollout-restarted (pod-template annotation kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt 2026-11-17T07:17:25Z, revision 2, unchanged 2.1.3 images). Each runs a single replica with no readiness or liveness probe, so the Services routed to the new containers immediately: the new ad container started 07:17:27Z but only logged 'Ad service started, listening on 8080' at 07:23:46Z, and the new payment container started 07:17:28Z but only logged 'payment gRPC server started on port 8080' at 07:18:38Z. Frontend spans show grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds failing with gRPC status 14 and 'connect ECONNREFUSED 100.65.180.246:8080', and checkout's oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge failing with 'dial tcp 100.70.188.60:8080: connect: connection refused'. Frontend error spans were 0 through 07:17:59Z, peaked at 3.9778 spans/s at 07:22:59Z and were back to 0 at 07:29:59Z. Neither ad nor payment produced any error-status span during the burst, and no NetworkPolicies or ResourceQuotas exist in the cluster and all nodes are Ready without pressure, so this is a startup availability gap created by the ad and payment restarts, not an application fault or an infrastructure constraint.

claims.text: Frontend error-status spans were 0 at every sample through 07:17:59Z, first became non-zero at 07:18:59Z, peaked at 3.9778 spans/s at 07:22:59Z and were 0 again at 07:29:59Z. The failing frontend operations were grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds and GET /api/data (both 0.8667/s at peak), grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and POST /api/checkout (0.1581/s at their peak), and tcp.connect (0.0489/s at peak); CartService/GetCart, CartService/AddItem and POST /api/cart error rates stayed at 0.

In frontend traces around 07:18:32-07:18:34Z, span grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds carried rpc.grpc.status_code 14 and grpc.error_message '14 UNAVAILABLE: No connection established. Last error: connect ECONNREFUSED 100.65.180.246:8080'; frontend 'tcp.connect' spans carried error=true with otel.status_description 'connect ECONNREFUSED 100.65.180.246:8080'; and the parent frontend GET /api/data, 'executing api route (pages) /api/data', GET and POST spans plus the frontend-proxy ingress and 'router frontend egress' spans in the same traces carried http.status_code 500.

In the same traces, checkout's oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder span (rpc.grpc.status_code 13) and its child oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge span (rpc.grpc.status_code 14) failed with 'could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection error: desc = "transport: Error while dialing: dial tcp 100.70.188.60:8080: connect: connection refused"', and checkout returned '13 INTERNAL' to the frontend's grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder span.

Kubernetes events in namespace otel-demo show Deployment ad 'Scaled up replica set ad-6cb57f76d from 0 to 1' at 07:17:25Z with old pod ad-554b849958-mbnxm stopped at 07:17:28Z, and new pod ad-6cb57f76d-xmcq6 Scheduled 07:17:25Z with container Created and Started at 07:17:27Z; Deployment payment shows 'Scaled up replica set payment-9c8ffb665 from 0 to 1' at 07:17:25Z with old pod payment-55766d76b9-c4wgb stopped at 07:17:29Z and new pod payment-9c8ffb665-qrm84 container Started at 07:17:28Z.

Deployments ad and payment carry spec.template.metadata.annotations['kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt'] = '2026-11-17T07:17:25Z' and deployment revision 2, with replicas 1, RollingUpdate maxSurge 25% / maxUnavailable 25%, images ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad and ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-payment, and both readinessProbe and livenessProbe null. The frontend Deployment has revision 1 and no restartedAt annotation.

Among the otel-demo Deployments, restartedAt is set only on ad (revision 2), payment (revision 2) and flagd (revision 2, restartedAt 2026-11-17T06:45:22Z); the other Deployments listed (including frontend, cart, checkout, accounting, product-catalog, recommendation) are revision 1 with restartedAt null.

The new ad container in pod ad-6cb57f76d-xmcq6 (startTime 07:17:25Z, single container, restart count 0, no previous container instance) wrote no log lines in the window 07:17:20-07:20:30Z; its first startup lines are 'Ad service starting.' at 07:21:52.827Z and 'Ad service started, listening on 8080' at 07:23:46.226Z, about 6m19s after container start at 07:17:27Z.

The new payment container in pod payment-9c8ffb665-qrm84 logged 'payment gRPC server started on port 8080' at 07:18:38.223Z, about 70s after its 07:17:28Z container start, and then logged 'Charge request received.' followed by 'Transaction complete.' from 07:18:52.124Z onward.

ad span throughput was about 3.5-4.3 spans/s in the samples up to 07:18:30Z, then 0 from 07:18:30Z until 07:27:30Z when it resumed at 5.3 spans/s; ad and payment error-status span rates were 0 at every sample in the incident window, while frontend and checkout carried the error spans.

checkout's error spans are exactly two operations with identical rates, oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and its client call oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, at 0.1391/s for 07:19:59Z, 0.1375/s at 07:20:59Z, 0.132/s at 07:21:59Z, 0.1222/s at 07:22:59Z and 0.0074/s at 07:23:59Z, then 0 from 07:24:59Z onward.

frontend pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-h8sk5 has startTime 06:43:42Z, restart count 0 and ready true, and the frontend Deployment was not part of the 07:17:25Z restart (revision 1, no restartedAt); frontend's own failures are its dependency client spans and HTTP 500 responses rather than a frontend restart.

The ad container is limited to cpu 50m and memory 450Mi (requests cpu 10m, memory 225Mi) and the payment container to cpu 20m and memory 160Mi (requests cpu 10m, memory 80Mi); events record that the new ad pod ad-6cb57f76d-xmcq6 and the new payment pod payment-9c8ffb665-qrm84 were both assigned to node i-0e9f8b08cc290a884.

The ad and payment Services are ClusterIP Services mapping port 8080 to targetPort 8080 with selectors opentelemetry.io/name=ad and opentelemetry.io/name=payment, matching the pod labels, so no Service port or selector misconfiguration was found for them.

The restart of Deployment ad is the origin of the dominant share of the frontend error rate: it replaced its only pod at 07:17:25-07:17:28Z with a container that had no readiness probe, did not listen on 8080 until 07:23:46Z, and the largest frontend error components (grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds and GET /api/data, 0.8667/s each of the 3.9778/s peak) are the ad path returning 'connect ECONNREFUSED 100.65.180.246:8080', which stopped once ad began listening.

The simultaneous restart of Deployment payment is the origin of the checkout-path errors: the new payment container had no listener on 8080 until 07:18:38Z, checkout's oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge client spans failed with 'connect: connection refused' to 100.70.188.60:8080, and checkout's PlaceOrder/Charge error rate fell to 0 from 07:24:59Z after payment was serving charges again.

NetworkPolicy and ResourceQuota are not the cause: a cluster-wide query for networkpolicies returned zero objects and a cluster-wide query for resourcequotas returned zero objects, so no NetworkPolicy refused the ad or payment connections and no quota blocked their pods.

Node pressure is not the cause: all five nodes report Ready=True with MemoryPressure=False, DiskPressure=False and PIDPressure=False, and node i-0e9f8b08cc290a884, which hosted both new pods, reports 4 CPUs allocatable and Ready=True.

The dependencies were not returning application errors: ad and payment error-status span rates were 0 across the incident window, ad logged normal 'Targeted ad request received' handling and payment logged 'Transaction complete.' for charges, while the failures observed by callers were TCP connection refusals before those servers listened on 8080.

Fault-injection flags in ConfigMap flagd-config were considered as this cause but do not match the observed failure path: the failures are TCP 'connection refused' on the ad and payment ClusterIPs while those servers were not yet listening on 8080, and neither ad nor payment produced an error-status span or an error log line during the burst, whereas these flags inject application-level errors on an established connection; the current flag defaults (adFailure 'on', paymentFailure '100%') are recorded only as an untested lead.

The flagd Deployment restart (restartedAt 2026-11-17T06:45:22Z, revision 2) was considered as the trigger for this alert but is not tied to it: frontend and checkout error-status span rates were 0 from 06:55:59Z through 07:17:59Z and the burst starts at 07:18:59Z, about 33 minutes after that restart.

The residual grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds error rate after ad began listening at 07:23:46Z, decaying to 0 by 07:29:59Z, is most plausibly the 5-minute rate window plus gRPC client reconnect/backoff in frontend rather than continued ad unavailability; this is not directly confirmed because no trace of the late window was available.

The very slow ad startup (no log line at all until 07:21:52Z, listener up only at 07:23:46Z) is consistent with the container's 50m CPU limit throttling its initialization on node i-0e9f8b08cc290a884, but no CPU-throttling metric or comparable baseline was available to confirm it.

Add a readinessProbe (and a startupProbe) to the ad and payment containers so their Service endpoints receive traffic only after the gRPC listener on 8080 is up, and consider maxUnavailable 0 or more than one replica for these single-replica rollouts.

Raise the ad container's 50m CPU limit or otherwise shorten its multi-minute startup so a restart does not open a long refusal window, and review from change history why ad and payment were both rollout-restarted at 07:17:25Z.

gaps: The actor or automation that applied the ad and payment rollout restarts at 2026-11-17T07:17:25Z is unknown: the change_history integration is not available in this Run, so only the pod-template restartedAt annotation and the ReplicaSet/Deployment events evidence the action.
flagd flag values in effect during 07:17-07:24Z could not be verified: ConfigMap flagd-config was read only at about 07:36Z and no configuration change history is available.

Jaeger held traces only up to 07:18:34Z (source_end_at), so the later part of the burst, after payment began listening, could not be inspected trace-by-trace and is known only from span metrics; five delivered log views were incomplete due to the line limit and one trace view was truncated at 124 omitted rows.

Six delivered views returned status no_data and therefore support nothing: the rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count query with rpc_grpc_status_code!='0' (c063c3a1-05b7-4c8b-bd20-b94342d45a59-t0:c75591ec-5f9e-45aa-8404-7798241d8cd6), the get_label_values call for rpc_grpc_status_code (e72af497-ddbb-4a50-b490-d17b915bb692-t1:7fada78c-0344-42ce-a25d-9a97d55e0bce), the ad log window 07:17:20-07:20:30Z (0cbe2107-3015-4174-95e7-5d9b33807bf3-t0:971ce140-2886-40ec-8ca2-175e58eec0ad), the ad log window 07:17:20-07:21:00Z (988acff5-04f1-4781-8e24-a7ab17661535-t0:884d24f5-ea79-43d2-ba27-933d037f03d1), the checkout error trace search for 07:20:30-07:23:00Z (d32b6c55-3f2d-4af7-b6ad-9f8f3d90511c-t0:6c86e54f-7a31-4fc7-a719-c7fc9be07585) and the frontend log filter for ECONNREFUSED/UNAVAILABLE/error (4a94a2fa-1670-44a6-a3d2-1259d36eecef-t0:055d866b-9923-4fb8-9ec6-bb19ff6054c6). These empty or failed results are unknown, not zero and not proof of absence: in particular the ad pod emitted no container log lines before 07:21:52Z as far as retained logs show, and frontend container logs were not readable (0 lines read).
No CPU-throttling or container-startup-duration metric was available, so the link between the ad container's 50m CPU limit and its 6m19s startup remains an unverified hypothesis.
The exact moment frontend's gRPC channels reconnected to ad and payment is not observable, so the residual error tail was attributed to client backoff only as a hypothesis.

Traces are a sampled view and span counts are not unique request counts; the parent-child edges cited come only from parent references visible in the retrieved spans, so no complete call chain is claimed.
next_steps: Check the deployment/change history (CI/CD run or Kubernetes audit log) for the rollout restart applied to Deployments ad and payment at 2026-11-17T07:17:25Z.
Add readiness and startup probes to ad and payment, then re-test a single-replica rolling restart to confirm no connection-refused requests reach the new pods.
If the slow ad startup recurs, collect container CPU throttling and startup timing for the ad container under its 50m limit.
Re-check flagd flag values from configuration history at 07:17Z to close out the adFailure and paymentFailure leads.
